links.outcome: Reference hallucination rates in chatbot responses to rosacea questions, by manual verification of cited sources
links.effect: Hallucination rates varied among the three chatbots; no numeric rates are given in the abstract.
links.quote: Reference analysis revealed variable hallucination rates among the evaluated models.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates responses from several LLM chatbots (ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek) to patient questions about rosacea, testing reliability, accuracy, readability, and hallucinations, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
